title: Final velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The response must state or calculate the final speed as 8 m/s.

title: Final air resistance magnitude
description: Essential: The response must state or calculate the air resistance force as 6 N.

title: Correct kinematic relation
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply a kinematic equation (e.g., s = (v0+vt)t/2 or s = 1/2 a t^2) to relate displacement, time, and velocity/acceleration.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: The solution must set up the force balance mg - f = ma using the calculated acceleration.

title: Acceleration calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the net acceleration (4 m/s²) from the given displacement and time.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculated quantities should be presented with correct SI units (m/s, m/s², N).

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the force equation is incorrectly written (e.g., f - mg = ma or mg + f = ma).

title: Using free-fall acceleration
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution incorrectly assumes acceleration is g (10 m/s²) instead of calculating the actual net acceleration.
